scenes: Jaja is happily planting colorful flowers in a beautiful garden
Tutu appears from behind a bush, looking curious
They discover a magical portal in the garden
Both characters enter the portal together
They arrive in a colorful fantasy world
Exploring a crystal cave with glowing minerals
Finding a treasure chest hidden in the cave
Opening the chest to reveal magical items
Jaja uses magic powers to help animals
Tutu flies with magical butterfly wings
Both characters dance in a rainbow waterfall
Watching a beautiful sunset over the fantasy land
Returning through the portal to the garden
Waving goodbye to new friends, promising to return
